item.text:
No additional independent defect was confirmed in this pass. The implementation remains at 24 confirmed findings; additional review of storage error ordering reinforced that the existing persistent-storage defect affects both atomic and direct append paths, including durable visibility after database reopen.

The highest-impact issues remain:

- Delta-snapshot synchronization corrupting decided application state.
- Failed persistent writes leaking into later commits.
- LFU clone state causing silent value corruption.
- `AppendError::Timeout` retry duplication.
- LRU bincode deserialization panic.

All reproduction sources, commands, and retained logs remain under `work/`, with the consolidated report at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
